calibrate.hint: Click two points on the depth axis and two on the value axis, as far apart as possible, and enter the value at each point. The axes are calibrated independently, so a skewed scan is not a problem.
calibrate.ok: The calibration is correct. Check that the grid lines fall on the lines of the chart.
calibrate.pickHint: Then click the point on the underlay

details.coneHint: Changing the CPT type sets the step to 0.2 m (mechanical) or 0.02 m (electrical). The type is stated; the measured values are not converted for it.
details.hint: Enter the header data. The origin is required and appears in the report.

footer.accuracy: A digitized CPT is less accurate than a measured file.
footer.confirmClose: The clicked points have not been saved yet. Close the screen anyway?

label.note: CPT {{id}} was digitized from paper or a scan (type: {{cone}}; origin: {{origin}}). The accuracy is lower than that of a measured file.

points.duplicates: {{n}} points are at the same depth as a later point; the last one clicked counts.
points.hint: Click the points along the line, from top to bottom. Drag a point to move it; right-click to remove it.
points.linearHint: Linear: between two points the value follows a straight line.
points.notCalibrated: The calibration is not complete yet; the line now follows the points in the order they were clicked.
points.reordered: The points have been sorted by depth.
points.result: Data series: {{n}} values from {{from}} to {{to}} m below ground level.
points.stepwiseHint: Stepwise: each reading holds until the next reading. Suits a mechanical CPT read every 0.2 m.

problem.depthPoints: click two points on the depth axis, not at the same spot
problem.depthValues: enter two different values for the depth axis
problem.groundLevel: Enter the ground level in m NAP.
problem.id: Enter the name or number of the CPT.
problem.idTaken: There is already a CPT {{id}} in this project; choose another name.
problem.noSeries: The points are closer together than the step; no data series results.
problem.origin: Enter the origin; it is required.
problem.parallel: the depth axis and the value axis are almost parallel; click the points on the two axes
problem.position: Enter both RD coordinates, or neither.
problem.qcPoints: Click at least two points on the qc line.
problem.secondPoints: Click at least two points on the line of the second series, or switch that series off.
problem.step: The step must be between 0.005 and 1 m.
problem.valuePoints: click two points on the value axis, not at the same spot
problem.valueValues: enter two different values for the value axis

ribbon.addTitle: Create a CPT from a chart on paper or in a PDF or scan: calibrate the axes and click along the line
ribbon.editTitle: Reopen the digitized CPT {{id}} to update points or data

save.hintDocument: No project is open: the CPT opens as a separate document.
save.hintProject: The CPT is added to the project and is then used like any other, including in the pile calculation.
save.marked: Stated as digitized ({{cone}}) in the chart, the report and the pile calculation.
save.points: {{n}} values at a step of {{step}} m, down to {{to}} m below ground level
save.qcOnly: qc only; fs and Rf are missing

stage.empty: Choose a PDF or image with the CPT chart on the right.
stage.label: Underlay with points

underlay.hint: Choose the PDF or the image (PNG or JPEG) with the CPT chart. For a PDF you choose the page; then crop to the chart with both axes.
underlay.missing: The underlay was not saved with this CPT. The points are in place; choose the same image again to see them on the scan.
underlay.navigate: Mouse wheel: zoom in and out. Drag: pan.
